verdict: modelai-llama.cpp achieves identical baseline inference performance to upstream llama.cpp while adding KV cache compaction via Attention Matching (arXiv:2602.16284). The select pipeline maintains >0.97 logit cosine similarity at 2-8x compression across all supported architectures at 4K-16K contexts.

key_findings.baseline_inference_parity: modelai matches upstream llama.cpp within noise on prefill and decode

unsupported.gemma3-12b: SWA architecture not in V0 scope

advantages_vs_ollama: Direct Metal GPU inference (no HTTP overhead)
Higher decode throughput (~27 vs ~26 tok/s on Qwen3-8B)
advantages_vs_upstream_llama_cpp: KV cache compaction via Attention Matching (arXiv:2602.16284)
Select pipeline: 0.997 avg cosine at 2-8x compression
7 compaction pipelines for different use cases
Long-context capacity extension with same memory
